body.name: Fixed-cohort deadline ranks
body.construction: For every Borel \(B\subseteq\mathcal E\), extend the boundary notation by \(s_x(\infty)=0\) and \(K_x(\infty,B)=0\).  Then \(A^U_x(r,t)=\inf_{u\in[t,\tau]\cup\{\infty\}}\{s_x(t)-s_x(u)+K_x(u,[0,r])\}\) and \(A^L_x(r,t)=\sup_{u\in[t,\tau]\cup\{\infty\}}\{s_x(u)-K_x(u,(r,\infty])\}\).
